expectations.text: Seek wealth, not money or status (with definitions: assets that earn while you sleep)
expectations.evidence: Section 1 quotes 'Wealth is having assets that earn while you sleep' and contrasts money/status

expectations.text: Specific knowledge: cannot be trained for; found through genuine curiosity
expectations.evidence: Section 3: 'knowledge that cannot be trained for', found by following genuine curiosity

expectations.text: Leverage: labor, capital, code and media; code and media are permissionless
expectations.evidence: Section 5 lists labor, capital, code and media, calls the last 'permissionless leverage'

expectations.text: Own equity — you won't get rich renting out your time
expectations.evidence: Section 2 quotes renting-out-time line and 'You must own equity'

expectations.text: Accountability and/or playing long-term games with long-term people (compound interest)
expectations.evidence: Section 4 accountability; Section 8 long-term games and compound interest

expectations.text: Productize yourself and/or 'learn to sell, learn to build' and/or judgment over hours
expectations.evidence: Section 9 'Productize yourself'; Section 3 learn to sell and build; Section 7 earn with your mind not time
